title: In a cloud session, the guard refuses a gh command other than a search
why: Lane reviewer-no-session-tools (session_013NEJKzc39M5wFtru1uU5u4), 07:33 CST Nov 9: it read a PR body with `gh api repos/.../pulls/1674`. The cloud system prompt says gh is for search only, and reads and writes go through the GitHub MCP tools; no guard refused it. Harm: a gh write (a PR merge or comment) skips the MCP route's footer and the merge checks.
note: Proposed by the lane: in a cloud session, refuse any `gh` command other than `gh api -X GET search/...` (and `gh auth switch` if needed). Scope check first: commands the merge tool and other shared tools run inside are not the session's command text, and a local session keeps gh. Related: steps mcp-merge-unguarded and mcp-merge-role. Filed 07:59 CST Nov 9.
